displayName: EncodingDB Canonical Suite — 1080p SDR final candidate

suiteReview.reviewer: Codex — AI-assisted frame/contact-sheet inspection and executed technical checks; no human sign-off
suiteReview.notes: Candidate source selection/freeze authorized by the 2026-09-09 assignment. All seven actual sources reviewed using retained temporal samples and full-resolution detail frames, full decode and six real encoder/rate cases per clip. Human deployment approval remains pending. Per-asset notices travel in the pack; no synthetic pilot or PL calibration promoted. See docs/canonical-suite/README.md for class proxies, letterboxing and source-normalization limitations.

clips.description: Sustained camera motion, running/turning actor, occlusion and irregular VFX action. Accepted as disclosed athletic-action proxy, not sporting-event footage; motion frames retain varied edges and no visible normalization damage.
